title: BOFT depth views for tied blocks

random_selection.live_conflict_check: git fetch origin --prune; no remote MA-276 branch found

hypothesis: One tied 8x8 block plus one butterfly-coordinate angle per depth step can recover four aligned logical layer functions with less inference state than independent depth blocks; unrelated layers need private state.
mirror_coordinate: One float32 scalar per depth step controlling 12 fixed butterfly pair rotations
logical_multiplicity: Four distinct layer operators and their composed depth function
task_family: Four depth steps apply W_l=B(m_l) W B(m_l)^T. B(m) is three butterfly stages at strides 1,2,4 with four Givens rotations per stage, stage multipliers [1,-0.7,0.5], all controlled by scalar m. Independent condition uses unrelated matrices. Evaluate layer outputs and the full four-step composition on held-out Gaussian inputs.

development.selection_metric: mean layer and composed-map held-out MSE across methods and both conditions

storage.authority: actual deterministic serialized inference payload bytes
storage.codec: binary tensor records charge field names, method/depth IDs, dtype, shape, raw bytes and headers

compute.operator_prepare_cost: Record per-depth BOFT operator generation from serialized coordinates separately; static operators are prepared once before serving a query batch, then applied input-side.

success_gate: On all fresh aligned worlds, composed-map MSE <=1e-5, Mirror actual payload <=0.5x untied full blocks, and Mirror coordinate-path throughput >=0.5x generated shared-residual control. Mirror-specific value also requires a better quality/byte/compute frontier than static per-step LoRA and generated modulation.
failure_gate: Mirror misses an aligned quality/storage/runtime gate or is Pareto-dominated by static LoRA or generated shared-residual modulation.
boundaries: Synthetic linear block with four depth steps
Teacher is aligned to one scalar-controlled butterfly orbit

amendments.change: Execute each saved BOFT view input-side with its operator prepared once per depth step, and report operator preparation cost separately.
amendments.reason: The first development runtime timing regenerated all 12 rotation matrices for every query batch. PA22 and the static depth-coordinate protocol imply a per-layer operator can be prepared once and reused. Initial timings remain preserved as invalidated diagnostics; task functions and fit setting did not change.
Development mean composed-map MSE was 0.014618 at rank 4, 0.014648 at rank 2, and 0.014699 at rank 1.

amendments.change: Report the deterministic per-depth BOFT matrices prepared from serialized angles as runtime workspace bytes, separately from serialized inference payload.
amendments.reason: The input-side execution caches four 8x8 float64 butterfly operators; this is ephemeral but resident while serving queries and should be visible in the storage/runtime frontier. This accounting does not change payload bytes or quality.
